# Data

**Nothing in this directory is generated by this project**, with one clearly-marked exception.

## Real datasets (what the model is trained and evaluated on)

| File | Source | Rows | Labels |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `train_transaction.csv` | [IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/c/ieee-fraud-detection) | ~590,540 | `isFraud`, ~3.5% positive |
| `fraudTrain.csv` | [Sparkov simulator output](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kartik2112/fraud-detection) | ~1.29M | `is_fraud`, ~0.5% positive |

Both require a Kaggle account and accepting the dataset terms:

```bash
./scripts/fetch_data.sh ieee      # or: sparkov
```

Neither file is committed — they are large and their licences do not permit redistribution.

## `fixture.csv` — the exception, and what it is *not*

`scripts/make_fixture_csv.py` writes a small synthetic file. It exists for exactly one reason: CI has no Kaggle credentials, and the `train-smoke` and `compose-smoke` jobs need *something* to push through `build_dataset → train → ONNX → serve` to prove the code path works.

**No metric in the README comes from this file.** If you see a PR-AUC quoted anywhere in this repository, it came from a real dataset. The fixture is scaffolding, and it is labelled as such at the top of the script that writes it.
